Failed to backup PhysicalDrive1: VSS snapshot creation failed: VSS_VOLUME_SUPPORT - snapshots are not supported for drive \\?\Volume{e0810dc6-1ed3-4239-bbad-9885dded36a0}\, err: VSS error: IVssBackupComponents.IsVolumeSupported: VSS_E_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND - The specified object was not found. This error means that Microsoft VSS failed to take a snapshot of your file systems and that the backup job will be unable to backup any files that are opened exclusively by other applications. The most common cause of this error is that VSS has been disabled on one or more of the volumes that are part of the backup. ()
